Definition: from G1702; a derider, i.e. (by implication) a false teacher:--mocker, scoffer.
BiblicalUsage: The mocker is the one who derides what is holy. Peter warns that scoffers will come in the last days, walking after their own lusts, in 2 Peter 3:3, and Jude says the same in Jude 1:18 — mockers in the last time, walking after their own ungodly lusts.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the scoffer's mark is not cleverness but appetite — he mocks because he wants to keep his lusts, and I want no part of that trade.
RelatedPeople: Simon Peter; Jude, Brother of James
